conditions.device: AMD Instinct MI300X (1 GPU; idle before the run, not monitored during it)
conditions.timing: audio file decode, features, model, text; model loading excluded
conditions.protocol: 1 warm-up pass, then 3 timed passes; reported value is the median pass
conditions.whisper: Hugging Face generate, greedy (num_beams=1); Mandarin clips use a Traditional Chinese prompt
conditions.embed2asr_batching: batch 1: default; batch 16: cross_file=True (chunks of different files batched together; about 4% of short clips can change by one unit; off by default)
conditions.memory: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated, includes the full audio encoder and the reader; not whole-process memory
conditions.cold_start: process start to first output: imports, model load, first inference; median of 3 runs
conditions.latency: batch 1: per clip (600 = 200 clips x 3 passes); batch 16: per batch (42 batches)
